newsitem.title: USA: IOWA-S MINN FEEDLOT CATTLE PRICES FIRM - USDA.
newsitem.headline: IOWA-S MINN FEEDLOT CATTLE PRICES FIRM - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were firm on a live basis, compared to Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade was moderate to active. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest moderate. Offerings moderate. Confirmed - 2,900 Week Ago - 10,700 Year Ago - 10,800 Wk to Date - 18,600 Week Ago - 16,900 Year Ago - 15,500
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1400 lbs 65.50-66.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
